approved: Income Tax (First Home Saver Accounts Misuse Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

Proposed matching consequential amendments raising the First Home Saver Accounts misuse tax rate from 46.5 to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, aligning it with the Medicare levy increase from 1.5 to two per cent that funds DisabilityCare Australia.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
Income Tax (First Home Saver Accounts Misuse Tax) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Act 2013
